WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    avg_signed_amount,
    transaction_count,
    transaction_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(transaction_count * 1.0) FROM account_stats) AS ratio
FROM account_stats
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
